proof_nl: Fix any real number x. By the definition of the floor function, floor(x) is the greatest integer less than or equal to x; in particular, floor(x) ≤ x. Subtracting floor(x) from both sides gives x - floor(x) ≥ 0. Since x was arbitrary, this holds for every real number x. Hence, for all real x, 0 ≤ x - floor(x).
